# Mental Health America

> > Mental Health America (MHA) is the nation's leading community-based nonprofit dedicated to addressing mental health needs through advocacy, education, research, and services.

MHA operates through a nationwide network of affiliates providing local mental health services, peer support programs, and community resources. The organization focuses on policy advocacy, workplace wellness, BIPOC mental health equity, crisis recovery, and youth mental health, while maintaining comprehensive data dashboards and screening tools to track mental health trends across states and counties.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health America (MHA)
- BIPOC mental health equity
- Workplace mental health
- Crisis recovery and trauma healing
- Youth mental health
- Peer support programs

## Core Resources & Data

- [State and County Dashboard](https://mhanational.org/data-in-your-community/mha-state-county-data): Interactive state & county mental health data dashboard from MHAScreening
- [Quick facts](https://mhanational.org/quick-facts): Mental health statistics from SAMHSA's NSDUH on prevalence & disorders
- [Facts about caregiving](https://mhanational.org/facts-about-caregiving): Caregiving statistics & demographics from AARP on caregiver stress
- [The Mental Health Bell](https://mhanational.org/the-mental-health-bell): History of MHA's Mental Health Bell as symbol of hope & advocacy

## Policy & Advocacy

- [Calls to Action for BIPOC Mental Health](https://mhanational.org/bipoc-mental-health/policy/calls-to-action-for-bipoc-mental-health): Policy advocacy calls to action for BIPOC mental health accessibility
- [2025 Policy Institute](https://mhanational.org/conference/2025-policy-institute): 2025 DC Policy Institute on behavioral health tech & workforce development
- [RPC Governors Award meeting: Mental health care can't be denied](https://mhanational.org/calendar/breathing-black-history-a-breathwork-meditation-celebrating-black-trailblazers): Regional Policy Council meeting on Gov. Pritzker's mental health access work

## Workplace & Organizational Wellness

- [Workplace Mental Health Toolkit](https://mhanational.org/workplace/workplace-mental-health-toolkit): Walgreens-sponsored toolkit for workplace mental health strategy & culture
- [Wellness programs, corporate wellness programs](https://mhanational.org/arc/programs/wellness-corporate-wellness-programs): Corporate wellness programs directory from MHA affiliates nationwide
- [Yo Pertenezco Aqui (I Belong Here): Supporting Latinx Professionals and Building Inclusive Teams](https://mhanational.org/calendar/yo-pertenezco-aqui-i-belong-here-supporting-latinx-professionals-and-building-inclusive-teams): Dr. Coleman webinar on Latinx workplace belonging & inclusive teams

## Crisis Support & Recovery

- [Coping and recovery](https://mhanational.org/crisis-services/coping-and-recovery): Crisis recovery resources covering PTSD, trauma healing & coping strategies
- [Strategies for Healthy Emotion Regulation During Uncertain Times](https://mhanational.org/calendar/strategies-for-healthy-emotion-regulation-during-uncertain-times): Marc Brackett webinar on emotional intelligence & regulation strategies
- [Providing "Extra Spoons" for those with Chronic Health Conditions](https://mhanational.org/calendar/providing-extra-spoons-for-those-with-chronic-health-conditions): Webinar on Extra Spoons mutual aid for chronic health conditions

## Affiliate Programs & Community Services

- [Affiliate programs](https://mhanational.org/arc/programs): MHA affiliate programs directory for local services & community resources
- [School-based services](https://mhanational.org/arc/programs/school-based-services): School-based mental health services directory from MHA affiliates

## Educational Resources & Guides

- [Ginny & Georgia: A guide to identity, coping, and friendship](https://mhanational.org/gg-guide): Mental health guide for Netflix's Ginny & Georgia on identity & coping
- [Listen to Students With Psychosis](https://mhanational.org/calendar/listen-to-students-with-psychosis): Webinar featuring Students With Psychosis on campus inclusion & advocacy
- [Are clinical trials safe?](https://mhanational.org/are-clinical-trials-safe): Clinical trial safety info covering IRB oversight & participant protection
